messages:
sam: quick note 8: sample app is surfacing a generic 500 with "internal error" for things like missing auth and quota breaches. new users can't tell if to retry or rotate keys.

maria: can you paste an example response?

sam: from staging logs:
```
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Content-Type: application/json

{ "error": "internal error" }
```

sam: this appears when signature is missing (should be 401) and when rate-limited (should be 429).

jess: yikes. that explains the spike in onboarding tickets. short-term we should normalize in the sample app into typed errors (RateLimitError/AuthError/ServerError) plus a stable error.code enum.

alejandro: i dug in 2: legacy proxies and a handful of internal services return different bodies. runtime doesn't currently canonicalize. we should add an edge mapping layer.

maria: two-pronged plan: (1) quick sample-app fix to parse & present actionable hints and (2) runtime ticket to map status/body -> stable error surface.

sam: sample fix idea: map 401 -> AuthError (include www-authenticate or hint), 429 -> RateLimitError (expose retry-after header), 5xx -> TransientServerError with optional retry_after. strip internal stacks from responses and add a support_id header instead.

jess: sample JS helper i can add: 
```js
function normalize(resp) {
  if (resp.status === 401) return { name: 'AuthError', code: 'ERR_AUTH', message: resp.body?.message || 'authentication required' }
  if (resp.status === 429) return { name: 'RateLimitError', code: 'ERR_RATE_LIMIT', retryAfter: resp.headers['retry-after'] }
  if (resp.status >= 500) return { name: 'TransientServerError', code: 'ERR_SERVER' }
  return { name: 'ApiError', code: 'ERR_UNKNOWN' }
}
```

jess: will also add small README blurb: "If code == ERR_RATE_LIMIT, honor retry-after or exponential backoff".

alejandro: infra: we'll add support_id response header and stop including stacks in payloads next week. internal logs will keep full trace.

maria: i'll file the runtime mapping ticket and tag eng-runtime + eng-infra. mark as P1 for the devex onboarding epic.

deploy-bot: build: sample-app `fix/error-shape` staged successfully 705

sam: thanks. let's make this part of the next SDK minor so SDKs expose typed exceptions by default.
